g.text: V10: each panel has one Compute lane. Colors label broad purposes; original kernel intervals and internal gaps are retained.
Red gap = full window outside compute and actual IO. Percentages exclude IO-only time; ECHO ranges are fused-IO bounds, not confidence intervals.
Both phases include startup, final norm / head, synchronization and commit. Same scale across methods within each phase; prefill and extend scales differ.
Existing intrusive NSYS profiles; displayed times are not independent benchmark times. No new GPU measurement.
